summary: This bill prevents licensed gun dealers from transferring their firearm inventory into personal collections or to employees after their license is revoked or not renewed, and prohibits selling those firearms for one year if they are moved to a personal collection.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly aims to close a perceived loophole allowing firearms dealers to transfer their inventory into personal collections or to employees when their license is revoked or expires, thereby avoiding standard background checks. This is a clear move towards stricter gun regulations.

The bill establishes new unlawful acts related to firearm transfers by former licensees and sets penalties for violations, including fines and imprisonment. This strengthens enforcement against specific firearm-related offenses.
